name: easygui-devcontainer
description: Show Linux GUI applications running in a Dev Container in a VS Code editor tab, using Xpra's official HTML5 client and a self-contained Xpra/Xvfb runtime that the extension downloads into its own storage. No Dockerfile changes, no root, nothing installed on the host.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && node test/run-tests.mjs --integration

easyGui.autoStart.description: Start the display server when the window opens (so DISPLAY is set in new terminals). The display tab opens with "EasyGUI: Start / Show Display" or the status bar item.

enumDescriptions: Ask before downloading the Xpra runtime.
Never download (the extension stays inactive until a runtime exists).
easyGui.installRuntime.description: Whether the Xpra runtime (about 35 MB, downloaded from the PepperCat-YamanekoVillage/xpra-runtime GitHub releases into the extension storage) may be downloaded automatically.

easyGui.displayNumber.description: X display number to use. 0 picks the first free display from :100.

easyGui.terminalEnvironment.description: Set DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY in new integrated terminals so GUI applications started there appear in VS Code.
